sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, dosage_form, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(trim(coalesce(generic_name, ''))) RLIKE '^(?:[0-9.,]+ ?%?[^a-z0-9-]+)?(?:(?:sodium|disodium|potassium|dipotassium|calcium|magnesium|hydrochloride|dihydrochloride|hcl|hydrobromide|sulfate|sulphate|phosphate|acetate|citrate|chloride|bromide|besylate|mesylate|maleate|tartrate|bitartrate|succinate|fumarate|gluconate|lactate|tromethamine|bicarbonate|carbonate|nitrate|hyclate|propionate|dipropionate|valerate|acetonide|pamoate|decanoate|meglumine|lysine|anhydrous|monohydrate|dihydrate|trihydrate|hexahydrate|base|free) +)*sodium(?:-[a-z]{4})?(?:[^a-z0-9-]+(?:sodium|disodium|potassium|dipotassium|calcium|magnesium|hydrochloride|dihydrochloride|hcl|hydrobromide|sulfate|sulphate|phosphate|acetate|citrate|chloride|bromide|besylate|mesylate|maleate|tartrate|bitartrate|succinate|fumarate|gluconate|lactate|tromethamine|bicarbonate|carbonate|nitrate|hyclate|propionate|dipropionate|valerate|acetonide|pamoate|decanoate|meglumine|lysine|anhydrous|monohydrate|dihydrate|trihydrate|hexahydrate|base|free))*[^a-z0-9-]+chloride(?:-[a-z]{4})?(?:[^a-z0-9-]+(?:sodium|disodium|potassium|dipotassium|calcium|magnesium|hydrochloride|dihydrochloride|hcl|hydrobromide|sulfate|sulphate|phosphate|acetate|citrate|chloride|bromide|besylate|mesylate|maleate|tartrate|bitartrate|succinate|fumarate|gluconate|lactate|tromethamine|bicarbonate|carbonate|nitrate|hyclate|propionate|dipropionate|valerate|acetonide|pamoate|decanoate|meglumine|lysine|anhydrous|monohydrate|dihydrate|trihydrate|hexahydrate|base|free))*(?:$|[^a-z0-9-].*)' OR package_ndc IN ('0019-1188-27', '0264-1800-31', '0264-7500-00', '0409-4888-10', '0409-6660-75', '0409-7101-67') ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc
